heroHeadline: Pentagon Orders US Forces to Heightened Readiness for Potential Iran Strikes
heroSubtitle: Day 223 (October 8, 2026): The Pentagon has placed US forces in a heightened combat readiness posture for potential strikes on Iran, as Iranian analysts warn Tehran increasingly views armed conflict as likely with the gap between diplomacy and open war narrowing.
